title: Ladoo Heist
hook: A bear is napping on Grandma's ladoos. Grab some, tiptoe home, bank them. Greedy pockets are LOUD pockets.

theme.keyArtPrompt: A huge sleeping brown bear in a flowery apron snoring on a pile of golden ladoos in a cozy grandma's kitchen, tiny kids in socks tiptoeing with arms full of sweets, warm lamplight, no text

sprites.player: tiny sneaky kid in socks, top-down cartoon
sprites.ladoo: golden round ladoo sweet, top-down cartoon
sprites.bear: sleeping brown bear in a flowery apron, top-down cartoon

timeline.hostLine: A GOLDEN LADOO just rolled up next to the bear! It's worth five. Who's brave enough?
Grandma dropped the whole tray! Ladoos everywhere!

host.intro: Shh! The bear is snoring on Grandma's ladoos. Grab up to three, sneak them to YOUR basket, and try not to jingle.
host.finale: Final ten seconds! Every ladoo counts DOUBLE. Run, little ladoo bandits, run!
host.tutorial: Stick to move. Touch ladoos to grab them (three max: heavy and loud). Bank them in your basket. Hold TIPTOE near the bear. Bump a carrier to steal one!
